Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Description: Gluttony Combo - lalalazy fork of Gluttony Combo. XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.85 - Upstream fix: using items no longer throws off the GCD counter
- Using an item mid-combat no longer corrupts the "GCDs used since combat start" counter that openers and auto-rotation timing rely on - action history now records item vs weaponskill/spell separately.
- "Last action used" and the on-screen action log now correctly tell items and actions apart.
- Hardened the action-category lookup so an unknown action ID can no longer throw (null-safe).
- All GluttonyCombo customizations preserved: Amnesia / Pacification / Silence handling, Pyretic / Reflect penalties, 15s raidwide-mitigation gate, WHM ground-heal targeting, SMN Aegis Uptime, BattleData, BLU engine.
